name: cal_3x10_v5
notes:
cal_3x10_v5 — 3 bands x 10 cells, hand-tuned in pimd_delaycal v1.48 Manual Nudge against fw v4.35, 2026-08-11. NOT swept: no threshold crossing was measured for any cell; the delays are the operator's placements, verified live against the measured means below.

CELL PLAN (1-based, as placed). The first four cells are AMPLITUDE-ANCHORED and matched ACROSS ALL THREE BANDS to the same voltages, so a given cell index means the same point on the decay whichever band it is in. The last five are TIME-anchored. Cells 5 and 6 straddle the null.
  1  2.4 V      measured 2396 / 2400 / 2401 mV (100 / 50 / 10 us bands)
  2  0.5 V      measured  498 /  499 /  499 mV
  3  250 mV     measured  248 /  250 /  249 mV
  4  125 mV     measured  124 /  125 /  124 mV
  5  the NULL MINIMUM, 60-80 mV — measured 59 / 64 / 69 mV, so the null is deepest on the 100 us band and shallowest on the 10 us band
  6  rising out of the null, about 90 mV — measured 91 / 90 / 90 mV
  7,8,9  GEOMETRIC ladder interpolated between cell 6 and cell 10; constant ratio 1.5431 / 1.4027 / 1.1574 per band. The ~110 mV air pedestal is reached by cell 7-8, so these carry decay RATE, not amplitude.
  10 the band's longest delay: 120.0 / 75.0 / 29.0 us. Only the 10 us band is at the hardware limit (29.095 us, 95 ns of margin before the 16-bit PWM duty overflows); the other two are carried over from cal_3x10_v3 and sit well short of their 219.091 / 149.093 us limits.

NO CELL IS RAILED — the largest reading is 2.4 V against the 5.000 V full scale, so every cell is a measurement rather than a limit. This is the first cal_3x10_* profile for which that is true; cal_3x10_v3 and the original cal_3x10_v4 both clipped cell 1 of every band. The null is now SAMPLED DELIBERATELY at its minimum rather than skipped, which the +97 mV front-end bias (fitted 2026-08-10) is what makes possible — cal_3x10_v2 had to skip that whole span.

CONDITIONS AT TUNING: pack 21.89 V (22 % SoC, the LOW end of the DESIGN §12 clean window), board 70.3 °C, air, fw v4.35, delaycal v1.48. Std dev across the whole 30-cell table was 0.00-0.10 mV over a 1866 s Manual Nudge run — every cell green. Amplitude-anchored delays move with pack state (43-51 mV/V, §12) and with board temperature, so cells 1-4 in particular will not sit on the same voltages at full charge or on a cold board. Pack-voltage window: full charge down to 21.5 V, but the anchors are only verified at the 21.89 V / 70.3 °C corner.

threshold_v is a PLACEHOLDER ORDERING KEY only — a 5.0 -> 0.5 V countdown carried over from cal_3x10_v4. It is not the voltage at these delays (the real values are the measured means listed above) and must not be mined as one; pimd_shape and pimd_corpus_check use it solely to sort cells by -threshold_v.
